# 90-Day Launch Plan: $35 Stainless-Steel Garlic Press (FBA, US)

## Start with the math

Rough per-unit economics at $34.99 (swap in your real COGS):

| Item | Estimate |
|---|---|
| Referral fee (15%) | $5.25 |
| FBA fulfillment fee | ~$5.00 |
| Landed COGS (assumed) | ~$8.00 |
| **Profit before ads** | **~$16.75** |

That puts **break-even ACoS around 45–48%**. Accept 60–80% ACoS in month one (you're buying rank and reviews), then pull it down to 30–35%.

**Positioning:** most garlic presses sell for $12–25, so $35 needs visible justification: heavy-gauge 304 stainless, one-piece construction, easy cleaning, dishwasher safe, lifetime warranty. If your images can't show why it beats OXO and Zyliss, fix that before spending a dollar on ads.

## Pre-launch (Weeks -3 to 0)

- **Brand Registry first:** it unlocks A+ Content, Vine, Sponsored Brands, Brand Analytics, and New Seller Incentives.
- **Keywords:** garlic press, garlic mincer, garlic crusher, stainless steel garlic press, heavy duty garlic press, garlic press easy clean. Primary terms go in the title; the rest in bullets and backend search terms.
- **Images (7 + video):** clean main image, benefits infographic, scale in hand, before/after minced garlic, cleaning demo, comparison vs. flimsy presses, warranty/what's in the box. Most shoppers decide on mobile, so check legibility on a phone.
- **A+ Content** with a comparison chart and brand story.
- **Inventory:** send ~1,000 units to FBA (confirm your capacity limits) and get a reorder quote and lead time now.

## Days 1–30: Ignite ($2,700 ad spend, ~$90/day)

- **Vine:** enroll on day one (up to 30 units). It's your fastest compliant path to early reviews.
- **Launch discount:** 20% coupon or Prime Exclusive Discount (~$28 effective). Budget for coupon fees.
- **Sponsored Products structure:**
  - Auto: $20/day
  - Exact match, 8–12 core keywords: $40/day, +50% top-of-search
  - Broad/phrase discovery: $15/day
  - Product targeting on competitor ASINs with lower ratings or higher prices: $15/day
- **Weekly:** move converting search terms into exact match; add negatives for terms with 15+ clicks and no orders.
- **Reviews:** use Request a Review on every order (or automate it). Package insert with use/care tips and warranty registration only; never incentivize reviews.
- **Goals:** 150–200 units sold, 10–20 reviews, page one for 3–5 exact keywords.

## Days 31–60: Optimize ($1,900, ~$63/day)

- Drop the coupon to 10%; remove it if CVR holds above ~12%.
- Shift budget to keywords converting under ~50% ACoS where organic rank is climbing; pause the rest.
- Launch **Sponsored Brands video** once you have ~15 reviews at 4.3+ stars.
- Run a branded-keyword defense campaign (cheap insurance against competitors targeting your name).
- Use **Manage Your Experiments** to test the main image or title once traffic qualifies.
- Read every review; fix recurring complaints in the listing or the product.
- **Reorder decision:** if you're averaging 8+ units/day, place the PO now.

## Days 61–90: Scale profitably ($1,400, ~$47/day)

- Return to full price; use short Prime Exclusive or 7-day deals around tentpole events.
- Target ACoS 30–35%, TACoS 15–20%.
- Add a small Sponsored Display retargeting campaign for detail-page viewers.
- Test external traffic (cooking creators, recipe content) with Amazon Attribution to earn the Brand Referral Bonus.
- Plan a second SKU or bundle (garlic peeler, silicone roller) to raise order value and share ad costs.

## Budget summary

| Phase | Ad spend | Daily | ACoS target |
|---|---|---|---|
| Days 1–30 | $2,700 | ~$90 | ≤80% |
| Days 31–60 | $1,900 | ~$63 | ≤50% |
| Days 61–90 | $1,400 | ~$47 | 30–35% |
| **Total** | **$6,000** | | |

## Inventory reality check

A realistic curve is ~5/day in month one, ~8/day in month two, and ~12/day in month three: roughly 750 units plus 30 Vine units by day 90. That leaves ~220 units, under three weeks of cover. **With a 45–60 day lead time, reorder by day 30–40.** Stocking out wipes out the ranking you paid for.

## Weekly KPIs

- Unit Session Percentage (CVR): target 12%+ by day 30
- Organic rank for your top 5 keywords
- Review count and star rating (aim for 25+ reviews at 4.4+ by day 90)
- ACoS and TACoS trend
- Days of inventory cover vs. lead time

## Watch-outs

- **Price resistance:** if CVR stays under 8% after 20+ reviews, test $29.99 before cutting ad spend.
- **Early negative reviews:** diagnose fast; one 1-star in your first ten reviews visibly hurts conversion.
- **Policy:** no review swaps, rebates-for-reviews, or friends-and-family reviews. The suspension risk isn't worth it.

# Conversion Rate Drop (14% → 8%): Diagnostic Checklist & Action Plan

A 43% relative drop in two weeks usually has one or two specific causes. Work top to bottom; the most common culprits come first.

## Step 1: Find out which number moved

Conversion = orders ÷ sessions. In Business Reports (Detail Page Sales and Traffic by Child Item), compare the two weeks before the drop with the two weeks after.

| Pattern | What it usually means |
|---|---|
| Sessions up, orders flat | Lower-quality traffic (ads, external, new keywords) |
| Sessions flat, orders down | Something changed on the page or in the offer |
| Both down | Lost visibility plus an offer or page problem |

Also split by child ASIN (one variation may be dragging the average), mobile vs. desktop, and ad-attributed vs. organic orders.

## Step 2: Diagnostic checklist

**Offer and Buy Box**
- [ ] Featured Offer (Buy Box) % below ~95%
- [ ] New sellers or hijackers on your listing
- [ ] Buy Box suppressed because the item is cheaper elsewhere (Walmart, your own site)
- [ ] Price changed (check your repricer and competing offers)
- [ ] Coupon, Prime discount, deal, or Subscribe & Save discount ended

**Availability and delivery**
- [ ] Low or poorly distributed FBA inventory, causing slower delivery dates or a lost Prime badge in some regions
- [ ] Best-selling size/color out of stock
- [ ] Stranded or stuck inbound inventory

**Reviews and social proof**
- [ ] Star rating crossed a display threshold (e.g., 4.3 to 4.2 shows 4 stars instead of 4.5)
- [ ] New critical reviews with photos at the top of the page
- [ ] Review count dropped (removals or a variation split)
- [ ] Negative AI review summary ("Customers say") or Q&A
- [ ] "Frequently returned item" badge
- [ ] Lost Amazon's Choice or Best Seller badge

**Listing content**
- [ ] Main image, title, or bullets changed by Amazon or another contributor
- [ ] A+ Content, video, or Brand Story missing
- [ ] Listing suppressed or flagged in Account Health
- [ ] Variations merged, split, or broken

**Competition**
- [ ] New competitor with a lower price, more reviews, or a better main image
- [ ] Competitor coupons or deals on your main keywords
- [ ] More competitor ads on your detail page

**Traffic quality**
- [ ] New or changed campaigns: broad/auto expansion, higher bids, new Sponsored Display audiences
- [ ] Search term report shows spend shifting to loosely related terms
- [ ] External traffic spike (influencer, deal site, Google) with low buying intent
- [ ] Brand Analytics Search Query Performance: are your cart-add and purchase shares down on core keywords, or is the whole market converting lower?

**Seasonality and account**
- [ ] Category-wide dip (compare with last year and SQP market data)
- [ ] Post-event hangover (Prime Day, Black Friday)
- [ ] Account Health warnings, product safety or hazmat reviews

**Finally:** view the live listing logged out, on mobile, from a few ZIP codes. Many problems are only visible this way.

## Step 3: Action plan

**Days 1–2: Triage**
1. Complete the checklist and compare the live page against your last known-good version (screenshots, flat files, or a tracking tool's history).
2. Fix hard breaks immediately: reinstate expired coupons, restore missing images or A+, clear suppressions, and report hijackers through Brand Registry (Report a Violation, plus a test buy if you suspect counterfeits).
3. Cut bids on, or pause, campaigns launched or changed in the last three weeks that convert at less than half your account average.

**Days 3–7: Fix the root cause**
- **Traffic problem:** negate search terms with 10–15+ clicks and no sales, move budget to proven exact-match terms, tighten Sponsored Display audiences, and tag external links with Amazon Attribution.
- **Offer problem:** reprice against current competitors, test a 5–15% coupon, restock, and fix inventory placement.
- **Reviews problem:** find the common complaint, fix the product, packaging, or instructions, set clearer expectations in images and bullets, and report reviews that violate policy.
- **Competition problem:** defend your brand terms and your own detail page with Sponsored Products and Sponsored Brands; sharpen your differentiators in image two and an A+ comparison chart.
- **Content problem:** restore the content and open a Seller Support case if it keeps reverting; Brand Registry gives you stronger content authority.

**Days 8–30: Rebuild and protect**
- Run Manage Your Experiments on the main image or title.
- Enroll in Vine if you need fresh reviews.
- Set daily alerts for conversion rate, Buy Box %, price, rating, and inventory cover.
- Keep a change log of every listing, price, and ad edit so the next drop takes minutes to diagnose.

## What recovery looks like

- Conversion back above 11–12% within two weeks of the fix, and near 14% within 30 days
- Buy Box at 98%+, a stable rating, and ACoS back on target

If you share before-and-after numbers for sessions, orders, Buy Box %, and ad spend, I can help narrow down the cause.
